notes.title: Save the Kingdom releasing now!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that "Save the Kingdom" has been released! Let us know what you think about it! 

The realm is in crisis. The king himself, the one to whom you are totally devoted, is forced to make a terrible decision.... You will have to escort his daughter, and your best friend, Princess Goldbraid, to an exotic kingdom no one knows about, to become the wife of a prince no one knows.

Game link [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2144560/Save_the_Kingdom/]here[/url].

notes.title: Delayed release date for "Save the Kingdom"
notes.notes:
Hello all players! We wanted to apologize for the delays in the release of "Save the Kingdom". We are working to add as much content into the game as possible, and the new estimated release date is October 12, 2022.
